standard_prerequisites.use: Schemes-side fpqc descent of pseudo-coherence (Derived Categories of Schemes), refinement of fpqc coverings of spaces by schemes (Topologies on Spaces), comparison of D_QCoh on the small etale site with the Zariski derived category and compatibility of pseudo-coherence under it (Derived Categories of Spaces, two lemmas).

core_obligations: Split into the easy pullback direction and the descent direction.
Reduce the covering and the test object to scheme-local situations.
Apply the schemes theorem and transfer back through the site-comparison lemmas.

proof_roadmap.step: Schemes refinement, etale-to-Zariski reconciliation, and the schemes descent theorem.

difficulty_reason: For an fpqc covering {X_i -> X} of algebraic spaces over S and E in D_QCoh(O_X), the lemma says E is m-pseudo-coherent iff each Lf_i^* E is. The retained proof is written: the forward direction is pullback preservation (Cohomology on Sites, lemma pseudo-coherent-pullback); for the converse the author first reduces to X_i schemes (Topologies on Spaces, lemma refine-fpqc-schemes), then picks a surjective etale U -> X by a scheme, forms the induced fpqc covering {U_i -> U} of schemes (lemma recognize-fpqc-covering), applies the schemes theorem (Derived Categories of Schemes, lemma pseudo-coherent-descends-fpqc), and reconciles the etale-site and Zariski-site viewpoints through two Derived Categories of Spaces lemmas (derived-quasi-coherent-small-etale-site identifying E|_U with the classical derived category of the scheme U, and descend-pseudo-coherent proving the two notions of pseudo-coherence agree). Retained author proof at lines 12992-13018.

dedup.scope: fpqc descent of absolute m-pseudo-coherence for complexes on algebraic spaces.
